{{Top}}
The '''Imperial Galactic Bank''', known also as '''Imperial Bank of Coruscant''', '''Imperial Bank''' or '''Galactic Bank''', was a [[Bank/Legends|bank]] associated with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
The system was used by most [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings within the galaxy, specifically within the territory of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], during the years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] and, later, the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its gargantuan headquarters was located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and teemed with [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] serving as security. After escaping from [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] attempted to withdraw funds from the Bank that he had stashed there while on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], having "earned" them by pawning off treasures stolen from [[Teroenza]], the [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] of that world. Unfortunately for Solo, the withdrawal was denied due to a freeze placed on the account by [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] [[Hal Horn]].<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref> [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] had an account in it.<ref name="SotE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>
